3. Credits

  • AI pages use credits: at present 10 for an AI page. The App shows the cost before you start. We may change costs or add features with their own cost; a change never takes credits you already have.
  • Every App Store account gets 30 credits once, to try the AI. Plans include credits each month (section 4).
  • Credits are reserved when you start and are given back automatically if the AI fails, times out, refuses the picture, or you cancel before it finishes.
  • Credits have no cash value, cannot be bought separately, exchanged, transferred or sold, and are not refundable by us. They belong to the anonymous account on your phone; deleting the account deletes them.
  • We may remove credits obtained through fraud, abuse of refunds, a fault in the App or a refunded purchase.

4. Plans and paying for them

Arista MAX and Arista ULTRA are auto-renewable subscriptions sold only through Apple's In-App Purchase. Apple takes the payment and holds the billing relationship.

  • MAX: monthly or annual, 600 credits every month (an annual plan gives them month by month). ULTRA: monthly, 2,000, 4,000 or 8,000 credits a month. MAX also unlocks pencil, pen and every palette.
  • Unused plan credits roll over while the plan is active, up to three months of its allowance; above that, the oldest are dropped first. When the plan ends (cancelled, expired or refunded), its credits end with it. The welcome credits do not expire.
  • Changing plans: moving up to a larger plan applies at once and keeps your balance; Apple refunds the unused part of the old plan. Moving down, or between monthly and annual MAX, applies at your next renewal, when the balance is trimmed to the new plan's limit.
  • A subscription renews automatically at the end of each period unless cancelled at least 24 hours before it ends. Manage or cancel it in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.
  • Refunds are Apple's to give, at reportaproblem.apple.com. If Apple refunds a purchase, the credits it gave are taken back.
  • We may change prices; a change reaches you only through Apple, with the notice and the choice to cancel that Apple requires.

5. Your pictures and what you make

  • Use only photos and pictures that you took, own, or have permission to use, and get the consent of the people in them before turning them into pages.
  • Do not use the App to make content that is sexual, that involves minors in any inappropriate way, that harasses or impersonates real people, that is hateful or violent, or that infringes anyone's rights. The AI services' safety filters may refuse a picture; refused pictures are not charged.
  • If an AI page comes out offensive or wrong, report it from the page (Share → Report this page) or by email. We answer reports within 48 hours and may suspend the AI features of an account that misuses them.
  • What you make in the App is yours. We claim no ownership of your photos or pages, and we never use them to train AI. You are responsible for how you use and share them.
  • AI output is made by third-party models (OpenAI). It can be imperfect, unexpected or similar to other people's output, and it may not be protected by copyright everywhere. Pages are for your personal, non-commercial use unless the law where you are allows more.

6. The service

The AI features need an internet connection and our server and third-party services, which may be unavailable at times. We may add, change or remove features, styles or models, and may stop the AI service; if we stop it while you have a paid plan, we will tell you in advance and stop renewals. Coloring, Original pages and your artworks keep working on your phone without the server.
